:{| width=50% style="{{Linear-gradient|top left|#d6c0a0,#a38e70}}; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px; font-weight: bold" | I want to try the tutorial event! |}
:{| style="{{Linear-gradient|left|#000066,#9999ff}}; color:white; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px; font-weight: bold" | Our kingdom has prepared a special tour of duty for newly enlisted troops such as you. Hopefully you make the best of it. |- | To begin the journey, simply talk to Alaune in Southern San d'Oria. She resides near the gate to West Ronfaure. |- | To rendezvous with her, ascend the stairs that lead southwest, which should take you to Northern San d'Oria. |- | Once there, proceed southward until you reach Southern San d'Oria. |- | I shall mark her position upon your map so you may locate her more easily once you are in that vicinity. |- | It is possible to check who has been marked on your map by opening the “Map” menu, selecting the “Markers” option, and then scrolling to the right. |- | Performing a “Wide Scan” from the “Map” menu also allows you to locate people in your vicinity, should that method prove more convenient. |}

:{| width=50% style="{{Linear-gradient|top left|#d6c0a0,#a38e70}}; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px; font-weight: bold" | Teach me about Records of Eminence! |}
:If you have completed First Step Forward:
:{| style="{{Linear-gradient|left|#000066,#9999ff}}; color:white; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px; font-weight: bold" | Open the main menu, go right to get to the next screen, and select “Objective List” under the “Quests” submenu. |- | Records of Eminence contains a plethora of objectives, many of which will surely fit your play style. It would behoove you to take advantage of this opportunity. |}
:If you have not completed First Step Forward:
:{| style="{{Linear-gradient|left|#000066,#9999ff}}; color:white; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px; font-weight: bold" | Whether decorated in battle or recently enlisted, all can benefit from trying their hand at Records of Eminence. It is a simple method for participating in Vana'diel's many adventures, and bestows rewards all its own. |- | Open the main menu, go right to get to the next screen, and select “Objective List” under the “Quests” submenu. |- | Select “Tutorial,” head to “Basics,” and accept the objective “First Step Forward” to get started down this magnificent road. |- | Permit me to provide you with a hint for completing “First Step Forward.” |- | Find the person designated by the objective in Southern San d'Oria. I shall mark their location on your map. |- | Records of Eminence contains a plethora of objectives, many of which will surely fit your play style. It would behoove you to take advantage of this opportunity. |}

:{| width=50% style="{{Linear-gradient|top left|#d6c0a0,#a38e70}}; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px; font-weight: bold" | Teach me about the Trust inititative! |}
:{| style="{{Linear-gradient|left|#000066,#9999ff}}; color:white; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px; font-weight: bold" | The Trust initiative is a special magic regimen developed by one of the world's finest academies of magic. |- | Those who successfully undergo training will be bestowed with the ability to call forth powerful allies into battle. |- | Only adventurers who have proven their worth by achieving level five are eligible to participate. I will provide you with further information when you reach that landmark. |- | Gondebaud is their representative, and he is stationed in Southern San d'Oria. I shall mark his location on your map should you desire to make further inquiries. |- | It is possible to check who has been marked on your map by opening the “Map” menu, selecting the “Markers” option, and then scrolling to the right. |- | Performing a “Wide Scan” from the “Map” menu also allows you to locate people in your vicinity, should that method prove more convenient. |}

:{| width=50% style="{{Linear-gradient|top left|#d6c0a0,#a38e70}}; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px; font-weight: bold" | How do I give items to people? |}
:{| style="{{Linear-gradient|left|#000066,#9999ff}}; color:white; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px; font-weight: bold" | The action of handing over objects to others is termed “trading” here. To trade items to people, open the main menu--which will appear on the right-hand side of your screen--and select “Trade.” |- | In the event you have neglected to target your interlocutor, please do so after selecting the “Trade” option. Afterwards, choose the item or items you wish to bequeath in the window that appears and hit “OK.” |- | This process will be an integral part of the quests and missions you shall undertake in the future, so I entreat you to commit it to memory. |- | Should you be in possession of an {{DialogueItem|Adventurer Coupon|adventurer coupon}}, please trade it to me. In return, I shall bestow some monetary remunerations upon you, care of the monarchy. |}
----
:{| width=50% style="{{Linear-gradient|top left|#d6c0a0,#a38e70}}; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px; font-weight: bold" | How do I fight outside town? |}
:{| style="{{Linear-gradient|left|#000066,#9999ff}}; color:white; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px; font-weight: bold" | It would behoove you to remember the following points when engaging in combat outside the city gates. One: outfit yourself with weapons and armor. Two: magic spells are learned from scrolls. |- | Thirdly--and of the utmost import--is that you “check” your adversaries before challenging them. It would not do for you to go charging into battle against an enemy who thoroughly outclasses you. |- | Finally, never forget to check your spoils of war. |}
----
:{| width=50% style="{{Linear-gradient|top left|#d6c0a0,#a38e70}}; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px; font-weight: bold" | What are quests and missions? |}
:{| style="{{Linear-gradient|left|#000066,#9999ff}}; color:white; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px; font-weight: bold" | Tasks issued by residents of the city for you to complete are called “quests.” Simply fulfill the requirements, such as procuring the desired item, to receive a reward. |- | On the other hand, orders handed down directly from those involved with the nation's administration are called “missions.” Converse with the guard by the gate for a more detailed explanation. |}
----
:{| width=50% style="{{Linear-gradient|top left|#d6c0a0,#a38e70}}; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px; font-weight: bold" | I have other questions. |}
:{| style="{{Linear-gradient|left|#000066,#9999ff}}; color:white; border-style: solid; border-width: 2px; font-weight: bold" | If you harbor doubts about something I have not yet touched upon, first open the main menu. From there, scroll right to the second page and select the “Help Desk” option. |- | Once you have done that, select “Help Desk” again from the list of categories that appears in the new window. Finally, enter the section entitled “I need help with the game controls.” |- | The answer to your question likely lies there. |}

[[de:Tenshodohändler]] [[Category:NPCs]] In order to be able to buy from these vendors you must become a member of the [[Tenshodo]]. These vendors mainly sell items that are associated with [[Ninja]]s, [[Samurai]]s, and [[Monk]]s, as well as some harder-to-find items.
They only buy a select few items from players. You will be presented with "select from your inventory" as a choice, and the items in your inventory they will not buy will be grayed out (except the 4 standard Tenshodo merchants, who buy the same items that standard merchants do). They pay more for items than standard vendors, and they also tend to sell items for more.
Prices are based on your [[Norg]] reputation. The higher your [[reputation]] there, the more they will pay when you sell, and the less you will pay when you buy. Most Tenshodo merchants aren't open all the time either (much the same as [[Guild Merchant]]s). Each location has its own hours. '''Merchant List''' (hours) *Bastok (1:00 - 23:00) **[[Jabbar]] ([[Ninja Tools]], [[Ninjutsu]], food & crafting ingredients, Absorb spells) **[[Silver Owl]] (Martial arts armor - level 8 & 18, martial arts weapons) *Nashmau (1:00 - 23:00) **[[Tsutsuroon]] ([[Ninja Tools]], food & crafting ingredients, martial arts weapons & armor) *Norg (9:00 - 23:00) **[[Achika]] (Martial arts armor) **[[Chiyo]] ([[Ninjutsu]], Absorb spells) **[[Jirokichi]] (Martial arts weapons) **[[Vuliaie]] ([[Ninja Tools]], food & crafting ingredients) '''Standard Tenshodo Merchants''' *Jeuno (always open) **[[Akamafula]] (Martial arts weapons & armor) **[[Amalasanda]] ([[Ninja Tools]], [[Ninjutsu]], food & crafting ingredients, spells, [[Mage's Ballad]]) **[[Ghebi Damomohe]] (food) *Norg (always open) **[[Solby-Maholby]] ([[Ninjutsu]], [[Earth Spirit]], [[Norg Waystone]], [[Lugworm]])
